title: Showers this afternoon, and it will *feel like 97*
sub:
Low 72°F · 60% chance of rain, mostly after midday · light south wind, 5 mph · UV 5, moderate
Sea is calm — waves about 2 feet. High tide 6:05 PM, low tide 12:16 PM.
Beach and pool in the morning. Take an umbrella for afternoon errands.
Weekend: Sat 86°F and mostly dry · Sun 87°F with morning showers.

title: Playa beaches checked *clear of sargassum* on Monday
sub:
On 16 November officials found no sargassum at Playacar Fase 2, Playa Caribe, Playa 72, Pelícanos and Cisne. Light scattered material at Playacar Fase 1, El Recodo and Mamitas.
The Navy's ocean institute sees a low chance of big arrivals here in the short term.
To report a beach problem, call ZOFEMAT — number in the caption.

title: Days of free city events against *gender violence*, from Nov 25
sub:
Playa del Carmen's programme runs 25 Nov to 10 Dec. Two free dates worth the diary, both Sat 28 Nov:
6 AM — 3 km run and walk at plaza 28 de Julio. Walk up, free; organisers ask for a donation of personal hygiene products.
Noon — Olimpia Coral Melo on Mexico's digital-violence law, at the Teatro de la Ciudad. Free entry.
The Palacio Municipal is lit orange on 23 Nov.
source: Ayuntamiento, via Noticaribe and Quinta Fuerza

title: Revolution Day is *today* — but Mexico took the day off on Monday
sub:
Mexico moves this holiday to the third Monday of November, so the rest day was Mon 16 Nov. Banks shut that day and reopened Tuesday the 17th.
Today, 20 November, is the real anniversary — 116 years since the 1910 revolution — but it is not the public holiday, and banks have been on normal hours since the 17th.
City hall is at Av. 20 Norte between Calle 8 and 10 Norte, Centro. Switchboard in the caption.
